{{Quote|To the Pykes you must go. To Oba Diah, yes.|[[Yoda]], to [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]]|<ref name="The Lost One" />}}
'''Oba Diah''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located close to [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]], in the [[Kessel sector/Legends|Kessel sector]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. The [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Pyke/Legends|Pyke]] [[Species/Legends|species]], it was the base of operations the [[Pyke Syndicate/Legends|Pyke Syndicate]], a criminal organization of [[Spice/Legends|spice]] dealers.
